system.description:
Your bloodline carries the charge of a storm that never fully passed. You crackle when you are angry.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Resistance 5 to lightning and thunder damage.
  • When you cast a damaging spell, you may add 1d6 lightning damage to one target — no save, no slot cost.
  • You are never harmed by natural weather and have advantage on navigation checks and checks to predict or read environmental conditions.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, call a storm for 1 minute centred on yourself — 30ft radius.
  • All creatures in range take 2d8 lightning damage per turn (Reflex save for half).
  • You gain a fly speed of 60ft for the duration.
  • Once per turn, as part of your action, hurl a lightning bolt — one target within 90ft takes 4d6 lightning (Reflex save for half).
